snippet.title: A Long Goodbye | Gameplay
snippet.description:
Available now for free on itch.io: https://fixgritt.itch.io/a-long-goodbye


My website: https://www.danamckaydesign.com/

A Long Goodbye is a short narrative game centered around two old friends who have to say their final goodbye over a phone conversation.
